title: HR & People Assistant
description:
HR & People Assistant

Salary: Dependent on experience
Location: Darlington / Hybrid Working
Contract: Permanent, Full Time
Benefits: Excellent benefits package

Looking to start your career in HR? This could be a brilliant place to do it.

We're recruiting for an exciting HR & People Assistant opportunity with a growing, ambitious organisation based in the Darlington area.

This is a junior-level role with huge potential. We're looking for someone confident, organised and genuinely passionate about building a career within HR. You don't need years of HR experience. What matters most is your attitude, energy, attention to detail and willingness to learn. There is also the potential for the successful person to undertake a HR apprenticeship alongside the role, giving you the opportunity to gain a recognised qualification while developing real, hands-on HR experience.

You'll be joining an organisation at an incredibly exciting stage of its journey, with a fantastic culture and a genuine focus on developing its people.

Working closely with the wider team, you'll provide day-to-day support across a really varied range of activities, including:
- Providing general HR administration and coordination
- Supporting recruitment activity from start to finish
- Arranging interviews and coordinating diaries
- Liaising with candidates and hiring managers
- Preparing recruitment and HR documentation
- Supporting onboarding and new starter processes
- Scheduling meetings, training and People activities
- Keeping HR systems, records and employee information up to date
- Helping to organise internal events and initiatives
- Supporting the People team with ad hoc projects
- Making sure everything runs smoothly behind the scenes

This role is all about potential. You could already have some HR, recruitment or administration experience, or you might be working in a completely different environment and looking for your first opportunity to break into HR.

We'd love to speak to someone who is:
- Passionate about work, positive and enthusiastic
- Genuinely passionate about developing a career in HR
- Hungry to learn and happy to get stuck in
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Confident communicating with different people
- Comfortable juggling several things at once
- Proactive and willing to take ownership
- Professional when dealing with confidential information
- A real team player with a can-do attitude

Most importantly, you'll be someone who wants to learn. You'll be surrounded by experienced people who can help you develop your knowledge and give you exposure to different areas of HR. This isn't just another HR administration role. It's an opportunity to build your career from the ground up within a fantastic organisation where you'll have the opportunity to learn, develop and take on more as you grow.

You'll benefit from:
- Fantastic exposure to HR and recruitment
- Potential to complete a HR apprenticeship
- Excellent learning and development opportunities
- Hybrid working
- Excellent company benefits
- A supportive, positive and inclusive culture
- The opportunity to join at an exciting stage of growth
- Real responsibility and the chance to learn from experienced professionals

Ready to start your HR career? If you're ambitious, people-focused and looking for an opportunity where you can learn, develop and genuinely build a career in HR, we'd love to hear from you.

title: HR Administrator
company: Baltic Recruitment Services Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Baltic Recruitment are delighted to be supporting a leading manufacturing organisation with their search for a HR Administrator to join their team, providing essential administrative support across the business.

Overall Purpose:
- To provide HR Administrator support ensuring the efficient day to day running of reception ensuring that reception and switchboard are covered at all times, providing a professional, welcoming reception service.
- Responsible for maintaining accurate employee records, supporting recruitment and onboarding processes, assisting with day-to-day HR administration and managing reception duties.
- This varied role requires excellent communication skills, attention to detail, discretion and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively. This role will be responsible for meeting room facilities at the Washington Manufacturing site overview of bookings, ensuring that arrangements are in place for the meeting, and additional arrangements such as catering and hotel booking/travel.

Key Duties:

Reception:
- To cover telephone/reception duties.
- Maintain HR email inbox and respond to general enquiries.
- Answer screen and direct incoming calls professionally
- To maintain the reception area in a clean, tidy and organised manner.
- Maintain Refreshment facilities, including order and stock control, vending machine liaison
- To carry out general reception administrative work, this to include:
- Ensuring sundry items i.e. stationary is checked, stock levels maintained and orders placed through current computer system, when necessary.
- Photocopier/Printer control and upkeep and sending emails as required,
- Scanning, filing and protection of documents in accordance with GDPR requirements
- To open, distribute and send out post on a daily basis.
- To ensure under GDPR, employee data is effectively controlled, securely managed and stored in one of our internal databases.
- Carry out HR admin duties including minute taking, meeting/interview & training scheduling.
- Greeting all site visitors, ensuring visitor procedures are adhered to at all times.
- Complete Visitor Inductions.
- Adding Site Induction check sheets are uploaded to Rocket Medical public documents.
- Ensuring relevant contractors adhere to HSE rules, asbestos and legionella management plans whilst onsite

Administrative Support:
- Providing general administration support for Head of Operations as required.
- Providing general administration support for Head of HR as required
- Providing appropriate refreshments and ordering lunches as required for site.
- To assist in organising social events.
- To assist with Health, Safety and Environment Administration.
- General duties include:
- Order Processing, maintaining and updating records accurately and in accordance with data protection requirements.
- Maintenance of data, HRIS System, QPulse and other relevant company databases including spreadsheet updates.
- General departmental administration duties.
- Planning, booking and recording training requirements of all staff.
- Customer telephone support, including queries.
- Auditing.
- Occupational Health Administration.
- Document Digitisation
- Handle confidential employee and business information with discretion.
- Ensure personal information is stored and processed securely.
- Support compliance with company HR policies and procedures.
- Assist with maintaining records required for employment and regulatory purposes.
- Promote a professional, inclusive and positive working environment

Quality Responsibilities:
- To ensure maintenance of quality standards and requirements by adhering to company procedures at all times.
- To maintain and improve upon the company's current activities in all environments and assistance with all future improvement activities.
- Continuously improve reception and administrative activities.

Accountability:
- To adhere to existing working practices, methods and procedures and to undertake training and development as identified and to respond positively and to new and alternative practices or systems.
- To co-operate in compliance with Health and Safety legislation, safe systems of work, policies and procedures in the performance of the duties of the post.
- To maintain total confidentiality and data protection as appropriate at all times.
- To undertake other duties and reasonable management instruction at all times.
- Taking responsibility for own personal development, in line with agreed annual performance objectives.

Key Requirements:
- GCSE English or Maths Grade C or above.
- Good standard of computer literacy and relevant software packages including: Microsoft Office/Excel.
- Experience of working within a business administration/HR type of role.
- Experience of handling sensitive/confidential information.
- Experience of data entry.

The Package:
- 26,000 - 29,000 per annum depending on experience.
- Monday - Friday, office based role.
- Pension contribution 5%.
- Pension Salary Sacrifice Scheme.
- Death In service Benefit 2 x Annual salary.
- Perkbox.
- Health Shield, Cash Health Scheme.

title: Hr Assistant
description:
Belmont Recruitment are currently looking for a HR Assistant to join Tyne and Wear Fire & Rescue Service on an initial 5 month temporary contract. This is a full-time role working 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

Key Responsibilities
- To serve as a point of contact for employees, providing smooth communication and timely response and resolution to queries.
- To maintain a basic knowledge of relevant HR and recruitment related legislation and best practice.
- To be responsible for the effective organisation and attendance of meetings/events, including the preparation of resources
- To act as the first point of contact to the People and Culture Department by providing cover for the Helpdesk, managing the helpdesk inbox and delivering excellence in customer service.
- Conduct audit checking for People related processes and compliance
- To support the department budget monitoring by processing financial documents (orders, delivery notes, invoices).

Essential Requirements
- Working in an HR/Recruitment/Admin environment.
- Experience of undertaking Admin duties.
- Knowledge of relevant HR and Financial systems.
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office Packages.
- Excellent communication skills

Please apply with an up to date CV ASAP if this role would be of interest to you!

title: Recruitment Resourcer (Permanent Recruitment)
description:
